parameters.content:
# ERP booking
The **only** place that writes to the ERP. Two ways in: right after approval, and every 5 minutes for anything still waiting (ERP maintenance). Row lock + unique key = never booked twice. After 5 failed attempts the document goes back to a person and Avanai is alerted.

parameters.query: select d.id as document_id, 'system' as actor from documents d cross join erp_status s where d.status = 'pending_erp' and s.available and d.erp_attempts < 5 order by d.created_at limit 50

with s as (select available from erp_status where id = 1), src as (select d.* from documents d, s where d.id = $1::uuid and d.status = 'pending_erp' and s.available for update of d skip locked), b as (insert into erp_invoices (document_id, supplier_vat_id, supplier_name, invoice_number, doc_type, invoice_date, due_date, currency, net_amount, vat_amount, gross_amount, po_number, booked_by) select id, supplier_vat_id, supplier_name, invoice_number, doc_type, invoice_date, due_date, currency, net_amount, vat_amount, gross_amount, po_number, $2 from src on conflict (supplier_vat_id, invoice_number) do nothing returning id), mine as (select e.id from erp_invoices e join src on e.supplier_vat_id = src.supplier_vat_id and e.invoice_number = src.invoice_number and e.document_id = src.id), res as (select case when exists (select 1 from b) or exists (select 1 from mine) then 'booked' else 'duplicate' end as st, coalesce((select id from b), (select id from mine)) as eid from src), u as (update documents d set status = res.st::doc_status, erp_invoice_id = res.eid, erp_attempts = d.erp_attempts + 1, last_error = null, updated_at = now(), reasons = case when res.st = 'duplicate' then d.reasons || '["ERP already has this supplier + invoice number."]'::jsonb else d.reasons end from res where d.id = $1::uuid returning d.id, d.status, d.erp_invoice_id), a as (insert into audit_log (actor, action, document_id, after, note) select $2, case when u.status = 'booked' then 'erp_booked' else 'erp_rejected_duplicate' end, u.id, jsonb_build_object('status', u.status, 'erp_invoice_id', u.erp_invoice_id), case when u.status = 'booked' then 'Booked in ERP.' else 'ERP refused: duplicate.' end from u returning 1), dn as (insert into audit_log (actor, action, document_id, note) select $2, 'erp_unavailable', $1::uuid, 'ERP not reachable. The booking waits and is retried every 5 minutes.' from s where not s.available and exists (select 1 from documents where id = $1::uuid and status = 'pending_erp') and not exists (select 1 from audit_log where document_id = $1::uuid and action = 'erp_unavailable' and ts > now() - interval '1 hour') returning 1) select coalesce((select status::text from u), case when (select available from s) then 'not_pending' else 'pending_erp' end) as status, $1 as document_id, (select available from s) as erp_available

with ex as (update alerts set occurrences = occurrences + 1, last_seen = now() where id = (select id from alerts where source = 'erp-booking' and message = 'ERP unavailable; bookings are queued and retried every 5 minutes' and not acknowledged and ts > now() - interval '24 hours' order by ts desc limit 1) returning id), ins as (insert into alerts (severity, source, message, details) select 'warning', 'erp-booking', 'ERP unavailable; bookings are queued and retried every 5 minutes', jsonb_build_object('document_id', $1)::jsonb where not exists (select 1 from ex) returning id) select (select id from ins) is not null as is_new, 'warning' as severity, 'erp-booking' as source, 'ERP unavailable; bookings are queued and retried every 5 minutes' as message

update alerts set acknowledged = true where source = 'erp-booking' and severity = 'warning' and not acknowledged and (select available from erp_status where id = 1) and not exists (select 1 from documents where status = 'pending_erp') returning id

with u as (update documents set erp_attempts = erp_attempts + 1, last_error = $2, status = case when erp_attempts + 1 >= 5 then 'needs_review'::doc_status else status end, reasons = case when erp_attempts + 1 >= 5 then reasons || jsonb_build_array('ERP booking failed 5 times: ' || $2 || '. Check the values, then approve again.') else reasons end where id = $1::uuid returning id, erp_attempts, status), l as (insert into audit_log (actor, action, document_id, note) select 'system', 'erp_error', u.id, 'Attempt ' || u.erp_attempts || ': ' || $2 from u returning 1) select u.erp_attempts >= 5 as parked, $1 as document_id, $2 as error from u

with ex as (update alerts set occurrences = occurrences + 1, last_seen = now() where id = (select id from alerts where source = 'erp-booking' and message = case when $2 then 'ERP booking failed 5 times; document returned to review' else 'ERP booking failed; will retry' end and not acknowledged and ts > now() - interval '24 hours' order by ts desc limit 1) returning id), ins as (insert into alerts (severity, source, message, details) select case when $2 then 'critical' else 'warning' end, 'erp-booking', case when $2 then 'ERP booking failed 5 times; document returned to review' else 'ERP booking failed; will retry' end, jsonb_build_object('document_id', $1, 'error', $3)::jsonb where not exists (select 1 from ex) returning id) select (select id from ins) is not null as is_new, case when $2 then 'critical' else 'warning' end as severity, 'erp-booking' as source, case when $2 then 'ERP booking failed 5 times; document returned to review' else 'ERP booking failed; will retry' end as message

parameters.subject: =[Hallmann intake · {{ $json.severity }}] {{ $json.message }}
